cards.text: The wall around Jerusalem is done, friend, and now it's time to dedicate it. So the Levites get sought out from all their homes and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate. ALL their homes, even the Levite who never answers the group chat.

cards.question: The Levites have arrived in Jerusalem for the dedication of the wall. What is this celebration going to sound like?

answers.text: Thanksgiving songs with cymbals and harps
Victory shouts with drums and flutes
Dancing songs with tambourines and pipes

cards.text: The singers get gathered up too, from the villages they had built for themselves around Jerusalem. But before anybody celebrates, the priests and Levites purify themselves.

cards.question: After purifying themselves, the priests and Levites purify the people, the gates and the ___.

cards.text: Now Nehemiah, the governor (Nehemiah 12:26), tells this next part himself. He gathers the leaders of Judah and appoints two great thanksgiving choirs.

cards.question: Nehemiah has two great thanksgiving choirs ready to go for the dedication of the wall. Where does the first choir march?

answers.text: Along the top of the wall
Around the outside of the city

cards.question: The first thanksgiving choir sets off along the top of the wall to the right. Which gate is it headed toward?

cards.text: Behind the choir come Hoshaiah with half the leaders of Judah, priests with trumpets, and Zechariah (a descendant of Asaph, a Levite singer) with his associates and their instruments. Friend, that's not a choir anymore, that's a whole PARADE on top of a wall.

cards.question: Zechariah and his associates play the musical instruments prescribed by ___ the man of God.
Nehemiah himself leads the first thanksgiving choir's procession.

cards.text: The one leading that procession is Ezra the scribe, the man who read the Book of the Law aloud to the people (Nehemiah 8:2-3).

At the Fountain Gate they go straight up the steps of the City of David, passing above the house of David, all the way to the Water Gate on the east. Singing AND climbing steps, friend, and I get winded hopping from the oven to the cooling rack!

cards.question: The second thanksgiving choir heads off to the left along the top of the wall, and Nehemiah follows it. Who comes along with him?

cards.text: That second choir marches past the Tower of the Ovens, and friend, I don't know what's in that tower, but I already want to live there. They keep going past gate after gate and finally stop at the Gate of the Guard.

cards.question: The two thanksgiving choirs went opposite ways along the wall. In the end, both choirs stand together in the ___ of God.

cards.text: In the house of God, the priests are standing there with their trumpets. Then the choirs sing out under the direction of Jezrahiah, and friend, that's TWO great choirs and one man keeping them on the beat.
That same day they offer great sacrifices, and there's rejoicing. Not polite clapping, friend, REJOICING.

cards.question: On the day the wall is dedicated, Jerusalem celebrates. What reason does Nehemiah give for it?

answers.text: God had given them great joy
The king had canceled their taxes

cards.question: Only the men got to join in the rejoicing at the dedication of the wall.
How far does the sound of Jerusalem's joy carry on the day the wall is dedicated?

answers.text: It stopped at the city gates

cards.text: Heard from AFAR, friend, and I spent YEARS in a junk drawer without one person hearing me. That same day, men are put over the storerooms, and the portions the Law sets for the priests and Levites come in from the fields of the villages.

cards.question: The people of Judah bring portions from their fields into the storerooms for the priests and Levites. Why?

answers.text: They rejoiced over the priests and Levites serving
A prophet had warned them to do it
They were afraid a famine was coming

cards.text: The priests and Levites do the service of their God and the service of purification, with the singers and gatekeepers right alongside them. Everybody's doing their part, and NOBODY is saying, "Oh, I thought YOU were handling that."

cards.question: The priests and Levites serve the way King David and his son ___ had prescribed.

cards.text: Long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, one of the Levite singers (1 Chronicles 15:16-19), there were directors for the singers. They led the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
Now fast forward to the days of Zerubbabel, who went up to Jerusalem with the priests and Levites (Nehemiah 12:1), and the days of Nehemiah. The singers and gatekeepers get daily portions.

cards.question: In the days of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the singers and gatekeepers.
The Levites get daily portions too, and they set aside daily portions for the descendants of ___.

cards.text: And that's where we'll pull this batch out of the oven for now, friend. Nehemiah's story isn't finished yet.
